name: delay_finder_full_narrow
description: Full-range band with excitation that only reaches 1.2 kHz: the band is not excited, the finder must refuse.

parameters.band_shape: -6 dB edges; raised cosine in log2(f), 1 octave wide, centred on each edge; upper edge clipped to (fs/2) * 2^-0.5
parameters.delay_sign: positive = measurement late: meas[i] = sum_k g_k * ref_clean(i - d_k) + noise
parameters.construction: x = excitation over a buffer covering the ref block and every path (periodic extension when excitation_period_samples is set); each path is an exact band-limited fractional shift of x (FFT phase ramp); ref = x + white noise 70 dB below x; meas = sum of paths + pink noise scaled to snr_db in the band (band weighting squared)

expect_semantics.accepted: status Accepted and |first.delay - an acceptable delay| <= tol
expect_semantics.ambiguous: status Ambiguous and a listed candidate within tol of an acceptable delay
expect_semantics.accepted_or_ambiguous: Ambiguous, or Accepted with first.delay within tol of an acceptable delay (inside span instead, when span is given)
expect_semantics.no_estimate: status NoEstimate with at least one of reasons_any

arrays.name: ref
arrays.description: reference block starting at ref_start; covers meas_start - 2400 .. meas_start + meas_length + 2400

arrays.name: meas.narrow_excitation
arrays.description: measurement block of case narrow_excitation, starting at narrow_excitation.meas_start
